def factor_size_adaptive_ey_zscore_no_large_lev(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    size_rank = df_copy["mkt_cap_float"].rolling(252, min_periods=60).rank(pct=True)
    w_large = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-10.0 * (size_rank - 0.5)))
    w_small = 1.0 - w_large
    # small cap: book yield with leverage penalty
    pb_pos = df_copy["pb_lf"].where(df_copy["pb_lf"] > 0, np.nan)
    book_yield = 1.0 / pb_pos
    debt_ratio = df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0
    small_val = book_yield * (1.0 - debt_ratio)
    # large cap: earnings yield time-series z-score (no leverage penalty)
    pe_pos = df_copy["pe_ttm"].where(df_copy["pe_ttm"] > 0, np.nan)
    earnings_yield = 1.0 / pe_pos
    mean_ey = earnings_yield.rolling(126, min_periods=63).mean()
    std_ey = earnings_yield.rolling(126, min_periods=63).std(ddof=1)
    zscore_ey = (earnings_yield - mean_ey) / std_ey.replace(0, np.nan)
    large_val = zscore_ey
    factor = w_small * small_val + w_large * large_val
    df_copy["factor_size_adaptive_ey_zscore_no_large_lev"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_size_adaptive_ey_zscore_no_large_lev"]
